entry.title: Awesome Home Assistant Updates on Sep 27, 2020
entry.content:
Apps / Official Apps

  • DuckDNS (⭐2.2k) - Updates your Duck DNS IP address and generate SSL using Let's Encrypt.
  • File editor (⭐2.2k) - Browser-based configuration file editor.
  • Mosquitto (⭐2.2k) - Fast and reliable MQTT broker.
  • Terminal & SSH (⭐2.2k) - Allows logging in remotely to using a web terminal or SSH client.
  • Samba (⭐2.2k) - Access your configuration files using Windows network shares.
  • NGINX SSL proxy (⭐2.2k) - Reverse proxy with SSL termination.
  • deCONZ (⭐2.2k) - Control a ZigBee network using ConBee or RaspBee hardware by Dresden Elektronik.
  • Let's Encrypt (⭐2.2k) - Get a free SSL certificate from Let's Encrypt; an open and automated certificate authority (CA).
  • MariaDB (⭐2.2k) - An open source relational database (fork of MySQL).

entry.title: Awesome Home Assistant Updates on Sep 25, 2019
entry.content:
In case you need help / Official Communities

  • Home Assistant Discord - Join the chat, most of us are there.
  • Home Assistant Community - The discussion forum, also used for feature requests.
  • Home Assistant Subreddit - If you are into Reddit, subscribe.

In case you need help / Other Communities

  • Dr. ZZs - Facebook group by Dr. Zzs.
  • ESPHome Discord - Get support for your DIY ESPHome project.

Public Configurations / Other Communities

  • Carlo Costanzo (⭐5.1k) - Probably the most documented configuration out there.
  • DubhAd (⭐686) - Also known as Tinkerer shares his configuration files.
  • geekofweek (⭐1.5k) - Has over 300+ automations.
  • Mahasri Kalavala (⭐273) - Impressive setup, with lots of different hardware working together.
  • Alok Saboo (⭐2k) - Also known as arsaboo. Regularly updated.
  • Aaron Bach (⭐279) - Also known as bachya. Regularly updated and includes numerous Dockerized services.
  • Franck Nijhof (⭐2k) - Hass.io based, very different configuration structure compared to others.

Apps / Third Party Apps

  • IDE (⭐60) - Advanced web-based IDE, based on Cloud9 IDE.
  • InfluxDB (⭐194) - Scalable datastore for metrics, events, and real-time analytics.
  • Grafana (⭐275) - Open platform for beautiful analytics and monitoring.
  • zigbee2mqtt (⭐571) - Zigbee to MQTT bridge, get rid of your proprietary Zigbee bridges.
  • TasmoAdmin (⭐253) - Centrally manage all your Sonoff-Tasmota devices.
  • Dropbox Sync (⭐131) - Upload your backup snapshots to Dropbox.
  • Log Viewer (⭐94) - Browser-based live log viewing utility.
  • Tautulli (⭐46) - Monitor and get statistics from your Plex server.
  • motionEye (⭐331) - Simple, elegant and feature-rich CCTV/NVR for your cameras.
  • Backup to Google Drive (⭐92) - Backup snapshots to Google Drive.
  • Matrix (⭐54) - A secure and decentralized communication platform.
  • Traccar (⭐158) - Modern GPS tracking platform.
  • Home Panel (⭐254) - A touch-compatible web frontend for controlling the home.
  • Hass.io Google Drive Backup (⭐3.5k) - A complete and easy to configure solution for backing up your snapshots to Google Drive.

Dashboards / Third Party Apps

  • Share the Love - Custom card demos and configuration examples for Lovelace.

Dashboards / Icon packs

  • Font Awesome Icons (⭐338) - Use the free icons from Font Awesome in your frontend.

Dashboards / Themes

  • Midnight - A dark theme by Marcel Hoffs.
  • Dark Cyan - A dark theme with cyan accents by Ryoen Deprouw.
  • Grey Night - A dark theme with grey accents by ksya.
  • Dark Red - A dark theme with red accents by Ryoen Deprouw.
  • Halloween - Pumpkins colored by Mahasri Kalavala.
  • Black and Green - A dark theme with pale green accents by GreenTurtwig.
  • Vintage - Give your frontend a vintage look with this theme by Anup Surendran.
  • Carbon Green - Light carbon theme with green accents by Reua.
  • Many Themes, One Repo (⭐210) - 13 Themes in a convenient ZIP file.

Dashboards / Custom Cards

  • Canvas Gauge Card (⭐216) - Use awesome gauges from canvas-gauges.com.
  • Mini Media Player (⭐1.7k) - A minimalistic media player card.
  • Mini Graph Card (⭐3.8k) - A minimalistic sensor graph card.
  • Slider Entity Row (⭐906) - Add a slider to adjust, e.g., the brightness of lights in lovelace entity cards.
  • Power Wheel Card (⭐181) - An intuitive way to represent the power that your home is consuming or producing.
  • Simple Thermostat (⭐807) - A simpler and more flexible thermostat card.
  • forked-daapd Card (⭐78) - Control a forked daapd instance.
  • Xiaomi Vacuum Card (⭐277) - Detailed card for Xiaomi vacuum cleaners (and others).
  • Simple Weather Card (⭐338) - A minimalistic weather card, inspired by Google Material Design.
  • Home Card (⭐197) - A quick glance of the state of your home.
  • Banner Card (⭐692) - A fluffy linkable banner with interactive glances to spice up your home dashboards.
  • Spotify Card (⭐405) - List and select from current available devices and users top playlists on Spotify.
  • Battery Entity (⭐236) - Displaying battery levels for battery entities.
  • Multiple Entity Row (⭐935) - Show multiple entity states or attributes on entity rows.
  • Home Feed Card (⭐297) - Display a combination of persistent notifications, calendar events, and entities in the style of a feed.

Custom Integrations / Alternative Dashboards

  • SmartIR (⭐2.7k) - Integrates devices using Broadlink IR.
  • Xiaomi Hygrothermo (⭐89) - Sensor platform for Xiaomi Mijia BT Hygrothermo temperature and humidity sensor.
  • Elasticsearch (⭐164) - Publishes events to Elasticsearch.
  • Alexa Media Player (⭐17) - Allow control of Amazon Alexa devices.
  • iCloud3 (⭐835) - Improved version of the iCloud device tracker component with a lot of capabilities.
  • Circadian Lighting (⭐882) - Slowly synchronizes your color-changing lights with the naturally occurring color temperature of the sky throughout the day.
  • HASS Aarlo (⭐466) - Asynchronous Arlo integration. Similar to the Arlo web site; monitors events and states for all base stations, cameras and doorbells.

DIY / Alternative Dashboards

  • ESPHome - Program ESP8266 boards and ESP32 boards using YAML.
  • Magic Cards (⭐608) - RFID scannable cards that you can program to do anything.

DIY / DIY Gateways

  • OpenMQTTGateway (⭐4k) - A flexible MQTT gateway for IR, RF, BLE, MiFlora, SMS, and many sensors.
  • esp8266 Milight Hub (⭐1k) - Alternative hub for Milight/LimitlessLED devices that uses MQTT.
  • zigbee2mqtt (⭐15k) - Zigbee to MQTT bridge, get rid of your proprietary Zigbee bridges.

DIY / DIY Projects

  • HA SwitchPlate - LCD Touchscreen wall switch replacement.
  • 📺 DIY Multisensor - $15, Temperature, Humidity, Light, Motion, and RGB LED, without soldering.
  • $10 WiFi RGB Bulb - In inexpensive RGB bulb that works on WiFi.
  • 433mhz/IR Bidirectional Gateway - Bidirectional with IR and 433mhz using ESP8266 and MQTT.
  • esp8266MQTTBlinds - Automate your window blinds using an ESP8266, a servo and MQTT.
  • Home Assistant's Hackster.io - A Hackster channel with multiple DIY projects.
  • ESP MQTT Digital LEDs (⭐514) - WS2811 LED Stripe for the JSON Light Component from BRUH.
  • Bed Presence Detection - ESP8266 based Bed Presence Detection.
  • NFC Scanner (⭐84) - Build an NFC tag/card scanner with an ESP8266, PN532 and MQTT.

Online Resources / Blogs

  • DIY Futurism - Brad posts articles with great instructions for new users.
  • Smart Home Hobby - Features budget friendly guides and information.
  • Self Hosted Home - Articles on DIY home automation projects and self hosted services.
  • Tinkering with Home Automation - Tinkerer's blog and guides.
  • HomeTechHacker - DIY Smarthome guides, reviews, and advice.
  • Intermittent Technology - Quindor's personal blog for pasting random (mostly technology related) things.

Online Resources / YouTube Channels

  • BurnsHA - Great informational and tutorial videos.
  • The Hook Up - Tutorials and more, also has videos on home automation in general.
  • JuanMTech - Easy to follow how-to videos, product reviews and more.
  • vCloudInfo - Publishes videos based on his home and GitHub repository.
  • digiblurDIY - Tutorials on hardware projects and Tasmota automations.
  • Intermit.Tech - Tutorials & reviews: Camera's, Home Networking, ESP8266 boards, Node-RED.

Online Resources / Podcasts

  • Home Assistant Podcast - Biweekly podcast with the latest news and interesting guests.

Online Resources / Twitter

  • @home_assistant - Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.
  • @hass_devs - Latest news on the development of Home Assistant for contributors.
  • @balloob - Founder of the Home Assistant project.
  • @pvizeli - Core developer and creator of the Hass.io project.
  • @frenck - Creator of this Awesome list and maintainer of the Home Assistant Community Apps project.
  • @ccostan - Blogger of all things Tech. Smart Home, #IOT & other Geeky subjects.
  • @HomeTechHacker - Guy friends call when #tech happens. Tweet 25-50x/week about #smarthome, #homenetwork, #cybersecurity, #Linux, #gadgets, and #life.
  • @hassioaddons - For all community app news and updates.
  • @Dr_Zzs - Great how-to videos and also streams live.

Uncategorized / Twitter

  • Room Assistant (⭐1.3k) - A companion client to handle sensors in multiple rooms.
  • Home Assistant Companion - iPhone/iPad/iOS App to control and monitor your home remotely.
  • Mi Flora via MQTT daemon (⭐623) - Collect and transfer Xiaomi Mi Flora plant sensor data via MQTT.
  • Developer Documentation - The official developer documentation.
  • HASS Configurator (⭐335) - Browser-based configuration file editor.
  • HA-Dockermon (⭐291) - A Node.js service for RESTful switches to control Docker containers.
  • homekit2mqtt (⭐356) - HomeKit to MQTT bridge.
  • Home Assistant Device Database - Database of supported/confirmed working devices.
  • Jinja Scripts for Curious Minds (⭐273) - Bunch of Jinja2 scripts helping you to understand it better.
  • Monitor (⭐2.1k) - Distributed advertisement-based BTLE presence detection reported via MQTT.
  • HASS-data-detective (⭐204) - Explore and analyse your database data.
  • ADB Intents - List of ADB intents to control Android Devices.
  • Home Assistant Config Helper for VSCode - Visual Studio Code Extension that provides auto-completion, config validation and snippets when editting your configuration.

Alternative Home Automation Software / Twitter

  • openHAB - Java-based and aims at being a universal integration platform.
  • Domoticz (⭐3.7k) - A lightweight Home Automation System.
  • SmartThings - Commercial home automation hub by Samsung.

Other Awesome Lists / Twitter

  • awesome-smarthome (⭐556) - Curated list of awesome SmartHome/Home Automation things.
  • awesome-iot (⭐3.9k) - Curated list of awesome Internet of Things projects and resources.
  • awesome-open-iot (⭐700) - Curated list of open source IoT frameworks, libraries and software.
  • awesome-amazon-alexa (⭐623) - Curated list of awesome resources for the Amazon Alexa platform.
